about: The fewest passing titles scripts/loam-exit-check.mjs --phase 3 accepts for each row, P3-E and P3-H, by the place its row names (phase 3 specification, section 18), so an exclude, a skipped suite or a deleted file cannot pass unnoticed. P3-E12 reads loam-exit-check.minimums.json, phase 2's; E10's budget and E16 have no count. P3-H1 to P3-H5 count the hosted criterion's step, and E8 counts it beside its unit places (step 10).

Each is the count a full run observed. When exit tests are added or removed on purpose, run the check on a run that has them with --phase 3 --print-minimums, and copy the counts it prints here in the same pull request, saying why each changed.
